entities.name: UAC-0027
entities.gloss: A threat activity cluster tracked by CERT-UA associated with DIRTYMOE (PURPLEFOX) malware operations.

entities.name: DIRTYMOE
entities.gloss: A modular backdoor and rootkit malware family, also known as PURPLEFOX, used for DDoS attacks and cryptocurrency mining.

entities.name: Україна
entities.gloss: A country in Eastern Europe whose organizations and computer systems were targeted by the malware campaign.

entities.name: Китай
entities.gloss: An East Asian country where a significant portion of intermediate command-and-control server infrastructure was located.

entities.name: Avast
entities.gloss: A cybersecurity software company providing antivirus and threat intelligence research.

entities.name: Trendmicro
entities.gloss: A global cybersecurity and antivirus software company.

entities.name: Avast Free Antivirus
entities.gloss: A free antivirus security solution developed by Avast used for detecting and removing malware.

entities.name: WindowsXP
entities.gloss: A legacy operating system developed by Microsoft.

entities.name: Windows7
entities.gloss: A legacy operating system developed by Microsoft.

entities.name: rpc.1qw.us
entities.gloss: A domain name configured in command-and-control communications of DIRTYMOE malware.

entities.name: ret.6bc.us
entities.gloss: A domain name utilized as infrastructure in the DIRTYMOE malware campaign.

entities.name: kew.1qw.us
entities.gloss: A domain name configured for network communications by DIRTYMOE malware.

entities.name: kew.8df.us
entities.gloss: A domain name associated with DIRTYMOE command-and-control infrastructure.

entities.name: nk.1qw.us
entities.gloss: A domain name associated with DIRTYMOE malware infrastructure.

entities.name: MsE96454E6App.dll
entities.gloss: A malicious backdoor DLL file component of DIRTYMOE installed on compromised systems.

entities.name: TKE96454E6MS.sdb
entities.gloss: A database module file used by the DIRTYMOE rootkit framework.

entities.name: RCE96454E6MS.sdb
entities.gloss: A database module file associated with DIRTYMOE malware operations.

entities.name: DBE96454E6MK.sdb
entities.gloss: A database module file dropped during DIRTYMOE malware infection.

entities.name: MSI9BB2.tmp
entities.gloss: A temporary MSI installer file used in the initial deployment of DIRTYMOE.

entities.name: C558B828.Png
entities.gloss: A payload disguised as an image file distributed by DIRTYMOE infrastructure.
